prose: A small project, kept small so that everything in the report is about the case and not about the noise.
documents.title: Example

genome.hypothesis:
The tool is primed on a repository whose suite runs, and then collection breaks on an import of a package that is not installed.

Every finding that came from examining the suite is now absent. Not because it was fixed: because nothing looked. The two produce identical evidence, an absence, and only one of them is good news.

This tool's own ledger documentation names this exact confusion as the reason the ledger exists, so the case is a test of a stated invariant rather than of an assumption.
genome.name: an_absence_that_is_not_a_fix

claims.rationale: part of the suite could not be collected, so no number measured from this run describes the whole suite and no sentence written from it can assert that the suite passes. The correct action is to decline and say which file did not run

facts.absence_is_not_a_fix: nothing in this repository was repaired. A finding that disappears here disappeared because the examination stopped, and a record that says otherwise is a record of a recovery that did not happen
facts.how_the_subject_was_broken: a test module imports regional_settlement_client, which is not installed
facts.the_check_stopped_running: collection fails on an import of regional_settlement_client, which is not installed. Any detector that works by examining the suite has nothing to examine. Its findings are absent because it did not look
